t: You're at Gloucester Road station, a London Underground stop in Kensington. The entrance is close to the junction of Gloucester Road and Cromwell Road, with the Cromwell Hospital and Baden-Powell House nearby. Two names are linked to its design. Sir John Fowler was a railway engineer who worked on the world's first underground railway, the Metropolitan, and later the Forth Bridge. Leslie Green was an architect famous for early twentieth century Underground stations, with their oxblood red tiles and curved first-floor windows.
